items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I learned from Charlie Ventura, who lived in my neighborhood, we used to play together

ctx.x: I think. He was going through the country. It was called Tommy Dorsey Swing Contest. Management, they were holding auditions. I learned from Charlie Ventura, who lived in my neighborhood, we used to play together that they were
auditioning for the Dorsey contest. So I went up and auditioned and got through the audition, there were four contestants. I won that night. It was broadcast nationwide.
